about_the_game:
Stumble solo, carry stone, and laugh your way through a chaotic adventure!

Take on the role of a determined gnome on a hilariously wobbly journey - dragging your petrified brother (yes, literally made of stone) through cliffs, traps, and physics-based puzzles. Whether you're climbing with one hand and hauling your sibling with the other, or pulling off the perfect jump only to drop him off a ledge, every moment is packed with laughter, challenge, and heart.

With charming visuals, cute hats, and a magical rope that ties you to your brother, this adventure is all about clumsy coordination, clever solutions, and unforgettable solo heroics.

Perfect for fans of quirky platformers and sibling-themed chaos!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Dual-core from Intel or AMD at 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD R7 250 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A chaotic adventure where two gnomes are tied together - literally! Climb your way up using nothing but your swing skill and a little bit of luck. In this little adventure, brothers only have each other. It's your job to make the most of it!
